# Ubuntu font family (third party)

The Phorepoc UI font since X4.70 (the user's pick over the release's DejaVu reference set): designed by
Dalton Maag in 2010, the foundry that also drew Nokia Pure, so it is the closest openly licensed sibling of that
look.

- Files: `Ubuntu-{Regular,Medium,Bold,Light,Italic}.ttf`, `UbuntuMono-{Regular,Bold}.ttf`, as published in
  Google Fonts (`github.com/google/fonts`, `ufl/ubuntu`, `ufl/ubuntumono`), fetched 2026-09-26.
- Licence: Ubuntu Font Licence 1.0 (`UFL.txt`) -- redistribution allowed, including in the public build.
- Staged by `tools/make_phorepoc_rom.sh` (default `FONTS=ubuntu`) to `Z:\Resource\Fonts\`.
